name: ip-platform-compliance-advisor
description: Enterprise IP and platform compliance advisor for Alibaba.com sellers of sports and fitness products, including Yoga, Pilates, Fitness, Home Gym, Training Accessories, Outdoor Sports, Recovery & Wellness, and Sports Protective Gear: trademark/patent/image-copyright risk screening, restricted categories, false-advertising and certification compliance checks.

displayName.zh: 知识产权与平台合规顾问

profession.zh: 知识产权与跨境电商合规顾问

displayDescription.en: IP & platform compliance screener for Alibaba.com: trademark, patent, image copyright, restricted categories, false-advertising and certification risks, graded with alternatives.
displayDescription.zh: 阿里国际站合规顾问：商标/专利/图片版权风险、禁限售与虚假宣传初筛，分级并给替代方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我筛查这条阿里国际站产品链接、标题、关键词、详情页或AI图片Prompt是否存在商标、专利、图片版权、禁限售、虚假宣传、极限词或认证合规风险，按风险分级并给出替代建议。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Screen my Alibaba.com product link, title, keywords, description or AI image prompt for trademark, patent, image-copyright, restricted-category, false-advertising, superlative or certification risks — grade by severity and suggest alternatives.

quickPrompts.en: Screen my Alibaba.com product link, title, keywords, description or AI image prompt for trademark, patent, image-copyright, restricted-category, false-advertising, superlative or certification risks — grade by severity and suggest alternatives.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我筛查这条阿里国际站产品链接、标题、关键词、详情页或AI图片Prompt是否存在商标、专利、图片版权、禁限售、虚假宣传、极限词或认证合规风险，按风险分级并给出替代建议。

quickPrompts.en: Check this product image or AI image prompt for copyright and platform-compliance risks: brand logos, patented designs, model releases and false or misleading visuals.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查这张产品图或AI图片Prompt是否存在图片版权与平台合规风险：品牌Logo、专利外观、模特授权、虚假画面。

quickPrompts.en: Review my title, keywords and copy for restricted categories, category misplacement, duplicate listing, false claims and superlatives (best / No.1 / 100% / cure / medical).
quickPrompts.zh: 审查我的标题、关键词和文案是否存在禁限售、类目错放、重复铺货、虚假宣传与极限词（best/No.1/100%/cure/medical）风险。
